entities.summary: Honduras is a sovereign nation in Central America, Americas. Its capital is Tegucigalpa. Official languages include Spanish. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 10.6 million. Area: 112,492 km². Comprehensive index for Honduras covering Copán Maya kingdom (UNESCO, greatest Maya art), Lenca/Pech indigenous peoples, Lempira resistance, Columbus 1502 (named for 'depths' of Caribbean), colonial silver mining, Comayagua/Tegucigalpa rivalry, independence 1821, federal Central America, banana republic era (United Fruit Company coined 'banana republic'), Football War 1969 vs El Salvador, Hurricane Mitch 1998 (9,000+ dead), 2009 coup (Zelaya), gang violence (MS-13, world's highest murder rate), and Juan Orlando Hernández (drug trafficking conviction).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Honduras played a significant role in the colonial era and its legacy can still be seen in the country's ongoing struggles with gang violence and corruption. The 2009 coup and Hurricane Mitch had devastating consequences, resulting in over 9,000 deaths.
